notes: RESPONSE INFERRED: read herbdata.Rd (a 1994 herbicide trial in southwestern Washington, three replications of 20 seedlings in a control block and a block treated with Oust, each seedling's basal diameter, height and status recorded at eight visits over ten years; Robinson and Hamann 2010) and the book code the package ships, inst/resources/scripts/book/data_management.r: it only plots height against basal diameter by treat and rep and by treat and date, divides CONTROL rep B's dia and dbh at the seventh visit by 2.54 as misrecorded units, and sums basal areas per plot; no model. Growth is rendered by treatment over date as a categorical visit. A seedling is treat:tree, since tree runs 1-60 within each treatment block (rep A 1-20, B 21-40, C 41-60); rep is a usable design column, and the six treat:rep plots, which a blind second reading added as a grouping factor, are left out as a weak component. isalive is an alternate response, dia and dbh alternate size measures (dbh 0 below breast height); a dead stem's measures are NA. Treatment was applied to one block each, so treat and block coincide.
